notes.title: Some unfortunate news (The game isn't cancelled)
notes.notes: [p]So as you guys know, this game has been at a stand still as far as updates and news goes. There is a reason for this. A few months back, CodeMora, the programmer for this game, had passed away. He was essentially the backbone that allowed my vision to take light. And with him gone, the game has been moving at a crawl. But to say this news hit hard would be an understatement. He was not only my programmer, but he was my friend, and he had given me so many ideas that I am using for this game. And it's because of that this game will continue. [/p][p][/p][p]I was very fortunate to meet a new programmer who has been helping with many of the new stuff for Isekai Cowboy. And I am really excited to show you what this game will have in store. Lots of areas for display, new enemies, and just a lot of cool stuff in general. This game means the world to me, and it meant a lot to CodeMora too. And because of that, this game will go on! [/p][p][/p][p]If you would like to keep updated, follow the game's X account at [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://x.com/TenmoraGames"]https://x.com/TenmoraGames[/url][/p][p][/p][p]This game will be something truly special. I just know it. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you everyone for your patience <3 [/p][p][/p][p]And expect a new demo with some new content. [/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely, Ten63[/p]

notes.title: The Final Demo Update
notes.notes:
So I had gone through a large overhaul on the demo itself. I fixed many things that my testers were bringing to my attention, and then I added a series of objects as well. These are the list of changes.

-Helper character added to assist in the forest
-Portraits for all important characters
-Added artwork
-Updated artwork
-New song added
-Enemy rebalancing
-The bunny bar has been opened for exploration (no activities are active yet)
-Added items hidden throughout the town
-Some rewriting to the script

Note: Because of the number of changes made to the demo, it is highly suggested that you restart your game.

I hope you guys enjoy the changes, and look forward to the finished product!
